_noteQ: Siphon Power. Direct hit: TotalMissileDamage = MissileDamage[rank] + MissileAPRatio(0.4)*AP -- matches wiki 'Magic Damage: 60/75/90/105/120 (+40% AP)' exactly. The cast ALSO grants Viktor 'Discharge': his next basic attack becomes a magic-damage-converted, non-projectile empowered hit -- curated as an onHit bonusEffect using BIN AttackTotalDMG = AABonusDamage[rank] + HitAPRatio(0.5)*AP + StatByCoefficient(mStat=2,mCoefficient=1)*totalAD, which matches the wiki's 'Modified Magic Damage: 20/45/70/95/120 (+100% AD) (+50% AP)' (the full replacement damage of that empowered auto, not an add-on) exactly. The wiki's separate 'Total Magic Damage: 80/120/160/200/240 (+100% AD)(+90% AP)' line is just device+Discharge SUMMED for display (60+20=80, 40%+50%=90% AP) and is not curated as a third number -- it would double count the two hits already curated.
_noteE: Hextech Ray. LaserDamage = BaseDamageLaser[rank] + LaserAPRatio(0.5)*AP -- matches wiki 'Magic Damage: 70/110/150/190/230 (+50% AP)' exactly. BIN also defines AftershockDamage (a delayed explosion along the beam's path) but per the live wiki this is ONLY available via the optional Glorious Evolution 'Augment: Aftershock' pick (P's 100-Hex-Fragment augment system) -- not baseline E behavior, and this engine has no live signal for which augment (if any) a player chose, so AftershockDamage is deliberately left uncurated rather than assumed-always-active (P2: no inference beyond what's actually guaranteed to happen).
_noteR: Arcane Storm. InitialBurstDamage = InitialBurstBaseDamage[rank] + InitialBurstAPRatio(0.5)*AP -- matches wiki 'Magic Damage: 100/175/250 (+50% AP)' at ranks 1-3. The singularity then remains for 6.5s, striking every 1s for up to MaxTicks=6 ticks: SubsequentBurstDamage = SubsequentBurstBaseDamage[rank] + SubsequentBurstAPRaio(0.35)*AP, matching wiki 'Magic Damage Per Tick: 65/105/145 (+35% AP)' exactly -- and Initial + 6xSubsequent reproduces the wiki's own 'Total Magic Damage: 490/805/1120 (+260% AP)' line precisely at all 3 ranks (e.g. rank1: 100 + 6x65 = 490), confirming 6 ticks is correct and not a guess. Curated as TWO hits (count 1 + count 6), assuming the full duration lands on one target -- the same 'assume full landed duration' convention as Darius E (count 7) and Garen E (count 7) elsewhere in this file set; a target who walks out of the moving storm early would take less than this in reality (tagged Zone on the tick hit for that reason). Tagged BurstCeiling at the slot level: Arcane Storm is Viktor's single highest realistic burst-damage contribution (his ultimate, up to ~1120 + 260% AP magic against one target who stays in the singularity).
